name: resistance band serratus wall slide with foam roll
description: Wall slide with a band and a foam roller between your forearms and the wall. It adds stability and serratus activation.
instructions: Put a band around your forearms and place a foam roller on the wall under them.
Press your forearms into the roller and push slightly out against the band.
Roll the roller up the wall as you reach overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders away from your ears.
